citation_entries.sentence: We cannot yet give you our teachers' writing on marriage, though our teachers did write on it.
Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact.
No record here shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages, so we will not describe how marriage was marked.

text: We cannot yet give you our teachers' writing on marriage, though our teachers did write on it. Our pastor at Geneva was a married man, and that much is a biographical fact. No record here shows how ordinary people lived out their marriages, so we will not describe how marriage was marked.
